Down jackets. Canada Goose, The North Face, and Patagonia. Excuse my language but these are the big fatty baddies of the winter jacket world. However, one brand that you most definitely heard of, Eddie Bauer, is the reason they all exist (and really, make jackets) today. Today we are diving butt first into the Eddie Bauer x Buck Mason Skyliner jacket and talking about how the heck we got here. In videos to come I'll be talking about how to find the perfect winter jacket for you! So stay tuned up!
